core: Epithelial-mesenchymal interactions in branching organ morphogenesis
qualifier: salivary gland and pancreatic duct lineages
name: Branching epithelial morphogenesis of salivary gland and pancreas
rationale: All members concern epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, epithelial branching or maturation in developing organs, and the salivary gland and pancreatic lineage members distinguish it from the lung, nephron and mammary/prostate confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation via VEGF production and signaling
name: Positive regulation of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Every member promotes VEGF production, VEGFR signaling or endothelial proliferation, migration and branching, separating it from confusables dominated by negative regulation, Tie2 signaling or receptor binding.

qualifier: estrogen and progesterone receptors
name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: Members are estrogen/estradiol responses, estrogen-dependent transcription and progesterone receptor signaling (with TFAP2 growth-factor regulation), whereas the confusables center on androgen receptor or mammary development.

qualifier: scavenger receptor classes A, B, F and H
name: Scavenger receptor-mediated ligand uptake and clearance
rationale: Members are scavenging by class A, B, F and H receptors plus related lipid storage, protein import and immune complex clearance, distinct from the hyaluronan, apoptotic-cell and iron/heme confusables.

qualifier: congenital muscular dystrophy (dystroglycanopathy) defects
name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and its congenital muscular dystrophies
rationale: All members are DAG1 core M1-M3 glycosylations or POMT1/POMT2/POMGNT1 defects causing dystroglycanopathy, unlike the dystrophin complex/muscle and GDP-mannose/CDG confusables.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and TKI resistance
qualifier: KIT and PDGFR
name: KIT and PDGFR oncogenic mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are KIT and PDGFR mutant signaling, inhibitor binding and drug-resistant variants, while the confusables cover FLT3, ALK and FGFR mutants.

qualifier: urogenital: micturition, erection, mating and parturition
name: Urogenital smooth muscle contraction in micturition and reproduction
rationale: Members are urinary, uterine and penile smooth muscle functions and associated reproductive acts plus peristalsis, distinguished from gastrointestinal motility, relaxation and tachykinin/GPCR confusables.

core: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in organ bud morphogenesis
qualifier: mesenchymal cell proliferation, lung mesenchyme
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and mesenchymal proliferation in organ buds
rationale: All members involve reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in salivary, lung and limb buds, with regulation of mesenchymal proliferation and lung mesenchyme setting it apart from prostate, pancreas/kidney and lung-epithelial branching confusables.

qualifier: atypical (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched) chain linkages
name: Atypical ubiquitin chain linkages in protein quality control
rationale: Members are non-K48 and branched ubiquitination, free chain synthesis, ERAD and misfolded-protein quality control, distinct from proteasome/K48 regulation, UPR and DUB/E1-E2 confusables.

core: Developmental WNT, NOTCH and Hedgehog signaling
qualifier: intracellular transduction and oncogenic pathway mutants
name: WNT, NOTCH and Hedgehog signal transduction and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members span canonical WNT/beta-catenin, NOTCH and GLI/SMO transduction including cancer mutants and regulated intramembrane proteolysis, whereas confusables focus on Hh/WNT ligand biogenesis, planar cell polarity or Hippo signaling.

qualifier: with ketone body synthesis and utilization
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA dehydrogenase beta-oxidation steps and ketogenesis/ketolysis, lacking the carnitine shuttle and branched-chain catabolism of the confusables.

core: Drug absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion
qualifier: aspirin, ciprofloxacin, atorvastatin and prednisone
name: ADME of aspirin, ciprofloxacin, atorvastatin and prednisone
rationale: All four members are pharmacokinetic pathways of these specific drugs, distinct from paracetamol/conjugation, xenobiotic metabolism and transporter confusables.

qualifier: serotonin synthesis/uptake and histamine
name: Serotonin synthesis and uptake and histamine signaling
rationale: Members are serotonin biosynthesis, secretion, transport and uptake together with histamine metabolism, receptors and responses, unlike catecholamine, MAO degradation and serotonin-receptor confusables.

qualifier: endothelial fluid shear stress response
name: Vascular wall development and endothelial fluid shear stress response
rationale: Members cover vascular smooth muscle development, perivascular/endothelial identity and endothelial laminar and oscillatory shear stress signaling, distinguishing it from SRF-target, eNOS and VSMC phenotypic-switching confusables.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycan and glycosphingolipid degradation disorders
name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycosphingolipid degradation and storage disorders
rationale: Members are lysosomal degradation of HS, CS/DS, keratan sulfate, hyaluronan and gangliosides and the mucopolysaccharidoses/gangliosidoses, distinct from GAG biosynthesis, sialic acid metabolism and generic lysosome confusables.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: attachment, entry, protein maturation and virion assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members are entry, protein processing, assembly and release steps of SARS-CoV, dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV, versus host restriction and PDZ-targeting confusables.

qualifier: adrenoleukodystrophy and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
name: Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation and spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and branched fatty acids plus ABCD1, CYP7B1, CYP2U1 and SLC33A1 disease defects, distinguished from alpha-oxidation and peroxisome biogenesis confusables.

qualifier: receptor-type tyrosine phosphatases and SALMs, presynaptic
name: Synapse assembly via RPTP and SALM trans-synaptic adhesion
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion, trans-synaptic complexes and presynaptic assembly involving receptor-type tyrosine phosphatases and SALMs, versus neurexin-neuroligin and postsynaptic clustering confusables.

qualifier: oxygen, carbon dioxide and Rh ammonium transport
name: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
rationale: Members combine heme biosynthesis, iron uptake and disorders, erythrocyte gas exchange and Rh-mediated ammonium transport, unlike oxygen-sensing, pathogen iron and other-metal confusables.

qualifier: synthesis, vesicular release and reuptake across transmitter classes
name: Neurotransmitter synthesis, vesicular release and reuptake
rationale: Members are synthesis, vesicle loading, toxin-sensitive release, reuptake and degradation of GABA, glutamate, monoamines and acetylcholine, distinct from receptor signaling, NMJ and sympathoadrenal development confusables.

qualifier: phosphatidylserine exposure and recognition
name: Phosphatidylserine-mediated recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells
rationale: All four members are steps of efferocytosis, whereas confusables are microglial activation or scavenger receptor pathways.

core: GPCR regulation of metabolic hormone secretion
qualifier: nutrient-sensing, glucagon, ghrelin and somatostatin receptors
name: Metabolic peptide hormone and nutrient-sensing GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid, glucagon, somatostatin and relaxin receptor signaling with ghrelin, glucagon and growth hormone secretion, distinguished from feeding-behavior and calcitonin/amylin confusables.

qualifier: loss-of-function MECP2 mutants and histone deacetylation
name: MECP2 neuronal gene repression and loss-of-function mutants
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes, its Rett-type binding and phosphorylation mutants, HDAC activity and memory, distinct from CREB/cAMP, behavior and MECP2-GABA confusables.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I-III transcription with rRNA, snRNA and mRNA processing
name: Nuclear RNA polymerase I-III transcription and RNA processing
rationale: Members are Pol I, II and III transcription, rRNA and snRNA maturation, splicing, 3'-end processing and nuclear RNA decay, unlike translation initiation, mRNA export and RNA modification confusables.

qualifier: maternal mRNA clearance and zygotic genome activation
name: Oocyte-to-embryo transition and maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: Members cover oocyte construction, maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation, zygotic epigenetic reprogramming and cleavage, distinct from P-body decay and piRNA/spermatogenesis confusables.
